verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud documents a first-party MCP server that every project gets, auto-configured to interact with project data and connectable to MCP-capable AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Cursor, so agents can use the indexes as a tool. The evidence only says the server lets agents 'interact with your data' and never specifies which tools it exposes, and the open-source library shows no MCP surface. Missing for 10: documented query tool definitions, analytics tools over MCP, index/data-source management operations via MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can use my search indexes as a tool — an MCP server or tool-calling surface exposes query, analytics, and index operations

citations.quote: Every Orama Cloud project comes with an MCP server that is automatically configured to interact with your project's data.
By copying the MCP Server URL, you can easily connect your Orama Cloud project to various AI assistants that support the MCP protocol.
you'll be able to interact with your data from different AI interfaces, including ChatGPT, Cursor, and many other
